interface.shortDescription: Multi-language code quality analysis — 20+ languages, six quality dimensions
interface.longDescription: Code Shine is a Codex CLI skill that diagnoses code quality across six dimensions: Cognitive Overload, Change Propagation, Knowledge Duplication, Accidental Complexity, Dependency Disorder, and Domain Model Distortion. It supports 20+ programming languages and produces structured Symptom → Source → Consequence → Remedy findings with severity labels and a 0–100 Health Score. Six analysis modes: PR review, architecture audit, tech debt, test quality, health dashboard, full sweep.
